theme: Skia m152, Graphite, and perf fixes
highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 bumps to Skia m152, adds Graphite GPU backend bindings, and fixes several native memory-safety bugs.
highlights_body: Alongside the engine bump, this release adds async pixel reads, a new Vulkan-via-Silk.NET package, and Nano Server font support via FreeType, plus a batch of performance and use-after-free fixes.

bullets.lead: Skia updated to Chrome milestone m152
bullets.detail: Bumps the bundled Skia engine to m152, folding in upstream m151/m152 stability and bug fixes.
Adds bindings for the Graphite GPU backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, opening the door to Skia's next-generation GPU pipeline.
Adds an async RequestReadPixels API to SKImage and SKSurface that works across GPU backends.
Ships a new package wiring Vulkan through Silk.NET, with Vulkan tests now running on Android and Linux.
Fixes use-after-free crashes in SKRegion.SpanIterator and SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With* by rooting the owning native object for the lifetime of the returned handle.
Fixes a native memory leak in the SKImage.Create raster failure path where the pixel buffer was not released.
Uses FreeType to provide font support on Nano Server, where the system font manager is unavailable.

bullets.lead: MSVC environment initialized once per native build
bullets.detail: Speeds up and stabilizes Windows native builds by initializing the MSVC environment a single time.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-based font support for Nano Server.
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Sped up Windows native builds by initializing the MSVC environment once.
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added the Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn.

harfbuzz_summary: Refreshes HarfBuzzSharp to 14.2.1, carried along with the repo-wide solution and CI infrastructure updates in this release.
